name: AI Environment Swap Explainer
description: Reverse-engineered from a Reel by @quantumfloww_media. One talking-head take, with the background replaced by a new AI-generated environment on every sentence boundary. Captions run as 2-3 word chunks over the speaker's chest. The speaker never changes; only the world around them does.
visual_style: photoreal AI-composited environments, clean product-film lighting, soft neutral base grade, one continuous performance
environment: a new generated setting per sentence: dotted white studio, poster-lined walkway, corridor of screens, dark showroom, bright open-plan office, retail floor, long dark table, isometric colour-blocked space
caption_style: bold white sans-serif, tight black rounded box, 2-3 words per chunk, one chunk per ~1.2s, no emoji, no colour highlight
typography: heavy grotesk, tight tracking, sentence case
color_grading: neutral, low saturation on the speaker, saturation carried by the environment
music_description: quiet ambient pad that never competes with the voice; no drop, no build
